title: Football & Cricket Ground Construction
summary: A playing surface is a structure, not a carpet. We build the ground from the sub-base up — civil work, steel, netting, padding and floodlighting — so the turf sits on something that drains and the fencing stands up to a struck ball.
rateNote: Indicative starting rates for planning. Final pricing follows a site survey — access, ground condition and area all move the number. GST is charged additionally at the applicable rate.

stages.title: Civil base and levelling
stages.summary: Everything above this fails if the base is wrong. Water has to leave the ground, and the surface has to be flat enough that a ball runs true.
detail: Plain cement concrete (PCC) sub-base, laid to a fall so water runs off
Three-layer crushed stone levelling: 50mm, then 25mm, then 10mm
Water levelling, drainage provision and parapet base
stages.alt: Workers screeding a wet concrete sub-base on a ground under construction

stages.title: Steel structure
stages.summary: The frame that carries the fencing. Two approaches, chosen by span and budget.
detail: Square section: 4" × 4" MS verticals, 3mm wall, at 20ft centres
Triangle section: L-angle 2mm, zigzag cross-braced, at 50ft centres
2" MS horizontals, 2mm wall, zigzag corner bracing
5mm base plates, 1ft × 1ft, on anchor fasteners
Red oxide primer throughout; access gate 4ft × 7ft

stages.title: Netting
stages.summary: Braided net on all four sides with a 12mm border rope, plus a lighter twisted net overhead.
detail: Vertical fencing: 2.5mm braided, 45mm or 38mm mesh, 12mm border rope on all four sides
Overhead: 1.75mm twisted net, 45mm or 38mm mesh
8mm stainless wire rope cross-support tying net to structure
stages.alt: Football being played inside a netted enclosure with padded red posts

stages.title: Padding and safety
stages.summary: Anywhere a player can run into steel gets covered. This is the part that separates a built ground from a fenced field.
detail: 15mm foam under rexine, 0.75" finished thickness
Vertical poles wrapped to 7ft height
Horizontal rails and gate frame padded
2 year warranty
stages.alt: Red rexine padding being wrapped around a steel post

stages.title: Floodlighting
stages.summary: Evening play is where a ground earns its money, and most bookings in Mumbai are after dark.
detail: Osram 240W LED floodlights
2.5mm two-core wiring throughout
L&T MCB distribution box
2 year warranty

stages.title: Turf laying
stages.summary: Rolled, seamed and dressed. The infill is what makes it play correctly and stand back up.
detail: Joint tape and adhesive seaming
Silica sand and SBR rubber infill, brushed in by hand
Installation included in the rate
stages.alt: Cricket being played on a laid artificial turf pitch
